flags.name: --permissions
flags.help: Limit the agent to these permissions (comma-separated, e.g. `customers.read,work_orders.write`). Default: everything you may do

flags.name: --irreversible
flags.help: Whether the agent may post invoices, take payments, void and delete: `yes` or `no`. Default: yes from the command line, no through a chat connector

examples: wenmar agents create parts-bot --permissions customers.read,work_orders.write --irreversible no

commands.name: revoke
commands.about: Revoke an agent token; the agent's next request fails with exit 2

commands.name: doctor
commands.about: Check version, config, server, credential, skill, and MCP; print fixes

commands.name: watch
commands.about: Watch work orders, customers, or vehicles and print one JSON line per change

flags.name: --resource
flags.help: What to watch

flags.name: --events
flags.help: Which changes to report, comma-separated (default: all)

flags.name: --since
flags.help: Report changes after this RFC 3339 time instead of from now

flags.name: --interval
flags.help: Time between polls (e.g. 10s, 1500ms, 2m; minimum 1s)

flags.name: --exit-on-first
flags.help: Exit 0 after the first reported change

flags.name: --run-sync
flags.help: Run CMD for each change and wait for it (event JSON on stdin)

flags.name: --run-async
flags.help: Start CMD for each change without waiting (at most 4 at once)

commands.name: mcp
commands.about: Run an MCP server on stdio for coding agents (uses the active profile's agent token)

commands.name: tui
commands.about: Open the terminal client: the screens the shop works in

flags.name: --font-size
flags.help: Windows: the console's font height in pixels for this window (the desktop shortcut passes 24). Other systems ignore it

commands.name: icon
commands.about: Write the Wenmar Pro icon to a file (.png, .ico or .icns)

args.name: FILE
args.help: Where to write it; the ending picks the format: .png, .ico or .icns
